promotions.description: EleBank's Visa Platinum Card comes with enhanced transaction security through the Bank Shield monitoring system. This feature provides real-time fraud protection 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, actively monitoring for suspicious activities on customers' accounts. The system is designed to detect potentially fraudulent transactions and prevent unauthorized card usage. This security feature is automatically included for all EleBank Visa Platinum cardholders at no additional cost as part of the bank's commitment to customer security.

This service is available to anyone looking to open an account with EleBank, regardless of asset level or status. The fast account opening process is part of EleBank's commitment to innovative banking technology and accessible financial services. No branch visit is required as the entire process can be completed online through the EleBank app.

promotions.title: No Account Management Fees and No Minimum Deposit

promotions.description: EleBank offers accounts with no account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements. This service is available to all EleBank customers as part of their standard account features. The no-fee policy applies to all basic account services, making banking more accessible for everyone regardless of their account balance. This permanent feature aligns with EleBank's philosophy of creating inclusive banking services that are available to all customers regardless of their financial status.

promotions.highlight: 💼 Personalized interest rates with loan amounts up to 12x monthly salary
promotions.description: EleBank offers personal loans with personalized preferential interest rates tailored to individual customers. Loan amounts can reach up to 12 times the customer's monthly salary or HKD1,000,000, whichever is lower. The application process is efficient, with funds potentially disbursed as quickly as 5 minutes after application approval. The actual annual percentage rate ranges from 7.43% to 35.05%, with repayment periods from 6 to 60 months, based on individual assessments.
promotions.cost: Variable interest rates from 7.43% to 35.05% APR

This service is available to all EleBank customers as part of their standard account offerings.

promotions.title: 24/7 Multi-Currency Foreign Exchange
promotions.highlight: 💱 Real-time currency exchange with instant crediting in 11 currencies
promotions.description: EleBank offers 24/7 foreign exchange services with real-time quotes and instant transactions. Customers can buy and sell currencies at any time with funds immediately credited to their accounts upon completion of the exchange. The service supports exchanges between 11 different currencies including HKD, USD, and RMB. This round-the-clock forex service allows customers to take advantage of favorable exchange rates at any time without being restricted by traditional banking hours.

promotions.title: Activate Money Safe, Get a Pacific Coffee Voucher
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced fraud protection with locked funds that still earn interest

It allows customers to lock funds for protection against fraud while still earning the same interest rates as regular savings or time deposits. The enhanced protection requires in-person verification at a branch to unlock funds, adding an extra layer of security against fraudulent transactions. This feature balances security with returns, ensuring customers don't have to sacrifice earnings for safety.

promotions.highlight: ⚡ Instant transfers 24/7 using phone numbers, email addresses, or account numbers
promotions.description: EleBank provides 24/7 instant transfer services for multiple currencies including HKD and RMB. Customers can send money using the recipient's phone number, email address, or account number, making transfers more convenient. The service utilizes Hong Kong's Faster Payment System (FPS) for real-time domestic transfers. This always-available transfer service allows customers to send money at any time without delays, regardless of banking hours or weekends.

promotions.title: Flexible Time Deposit with Interest Rate Boost Coupons

promotions.description: EleBank offers flexible time deposit options that can be opened at any time through the digital banking platform. Customers can select from various tenures to match their financial needs and goals. Interest rate boost vouchers are available to help customers earn enhanced returns on their deposits. The time deposit service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, allowing customers to open new deposits at their convenience without visiting a branch.

promotions.title: 24/7 Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🕗 Round-the-clock access to banking services
promotions.description: EleBank provides 24/7 digital banking services allowing customers to manage their finances anytime, anywhere. Customers can access a complete range of banking services including transfers, deposits, loans, and foreign currency exchange through a single app. The service includes 24-hour customer service hotline support for any assistance needed. This always-on banking platform ensures maximum convenience for all EleBank customers regardless of time constraints.

promotions.title: Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rate Boost
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enhanced interest rates for forex time deposits
promotions.description: Customers who exchange foreign currencies can enjoy boosted interest rates on time deposits with Fusion Bank. This offer applies to various currencies including USD, HKD, and RMB with no upper limit on deposit amounts.

promotions.title: Foreign Currency Exchange Reward Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💱 Exchange currencies with real-time rates during service hours
promotions.description: Foreign exchange service available Monday to Friday (working days) from 9:00am to 5:00pm. Allows customers to exchange currencies at real-time market rates, though service will be suspended during Black Rainstorm or Typhoon Signal No.8 or above.

promotions.title: Foreign Exchange Rewards Campaign
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Special rewards for foreign currency exchange
promotions.description: Special promotion for customers exchanging currencies with Fusion Bank. The campaign includes benefits for exchanging between HKD, USD, and CNY with no upper limit on transaction amounts.

promotions.title: Fixed Deposit Bonus Interest for Foreign Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: 💱 Special exchange rates and time deposit bonus interest
promotions.description: Promotional offer for foreign currency exchange featuring bonus interest rates on time deposits. Includes currency exchange between USD, HKD, and RMB with no upper limit on transaction amount.

promotions.title: liviSave Preferential Savings Rate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn with preferential savings rate with no minimum deposit
promotions.description: liviSave offers customers a preferential savings rate without requiring any minimum deposit. The account is designed to be flexible, allowing customers to earn interest while maintaining accessibility to their funds. Account opening is 100% online, quick, and easy with no complicated documents needed, allowing users to join anytime and anywhere through the mobile app. This promotion is subject to terms and conditions that apply to the preferential rate offer.

promotions.title: livi FPS Instant Free Transfers
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Fast and free money transfers anytime with FPS
promotions.description: livi bank offers instant money transfers through the Faster Payment System (FPS) allowing customers to send funds to anyone at any time. This service is completely free with no transaction fees applied. Customers can use the livi app to make transfers quickly and securely to other banks or e-wallet accounts that support FPS in Hong Kong. The service operates 24/7, enabling customers to transfer money whenever needed without waiting for processing periods.

promotions.title: Fast and Secure QR Payment Service
promotions.highlight: 📱 Fast and secure QR payments accepted across Hong Kong
promotions.description: livi bank offers a convenient QR Payment service that allows customers to make purchases at merchants throughout Hong Kong. This feature provides a fast, simple and secure shopping experience through QR code technology. Customers can use the livi app to scan merchant QR codes for seamless transactions. The service integrates with livi's security features to ensure all transactions are protected and trackable.

promotions.title: livi Rewards Program - Happiness
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Everyday delights and rewards for livi customers
promotions.description: The livi Rewards program offers everyday delights and rewards to livi customers across their banking activities. As mentioned in 'Our Story' section, livi focuses on bringing rewards to enhance the customer experience. This program is part of livi's commitment to adding value to customers' daily lives. Customers can access these rewards through the livi app, with the 'Happiness livi Rewards is here' feature highlighting the availability of these benefits.

promotions.title: Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Comprehensive travel insurance protection
promotions.description: livi bank offers the Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan to provide travelers with comprehensive protection during their journeys. This insurance product covers various travel-related risks and emergencies that customers might face while traveling. The plan is designed to give peace of mind to livi customers who are planning trips. Customers can apply for and manage their travel insurance through livi's digital platform, with the protection being backed by livi's trusted financial services framework.

promotions.title: Easy HomeCare Insurance
promotions.highlight: 🏠 Protection for your home and belongings
promotions.description: livi bank provides Easy HomeCare insurance to protect customers' homes and belongings. This insurance product offers coverage against various risks that might affect residential properties. The Easy HomeCare plan is part of livi's insurance offerings, designed to provide peace of mind for homeowners and renters. Customers can apply for and manage their home insurance through livi's digital platform, with the protection being integrated with livi's secure banking infrastructure.

promotions.title: Pet Care Insurance
promotions.highlight: 🐾 Insurance coverage for your beloved pets
promotions.description: livi bank offers Pet Care insurance to provide coverage for customers' pets. This insurance product helps pet owners manage unexpected veterinary expenses and other pet-related costs. The Pet Care plan demonstrates livi's commitment to comprehensive financial services that address diverse customer needs. Customers can apply for and manage their pet insurance through livi's digital platform, with the service incorporating the same security and convenience features as livi's other banking products.

promotions.title: livi Flexi Loan - Personal Loan
promotions.highlight: 💵 Flexible personal loan service
promotions.description: livi Flexi Loan offers a personal loan service designed to provide financial flexibility to customers. This product allows customers to borrow funds for personal use with customizable terms. The service is accessible through livi's digital platform, making the application and management process convenient. As with all livi products, the loan service incorporates the bank's security measures to ensure safe transactions and account management.

promotions.title: livi Flexi Loan - Balance Transfer
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Convenient balance transfer service
promotions.description: The livi Flexi Loan Balance Transfer service allows customers to transfer outstanding balances from other credit facilities to livi. This service helps customers manage their debts more effectively by potentially offering better interest rates or terms. The balance transfer option is part of livi's comprehensive loan offerings, accessible through their digital platform. As with all livi services, the balance transfer incorporates security features to ensure safe transactions.

promotions.title: livi Business SME Financing
promotions.highlight: 💰 Financial solutions for small and medium enterprises
promotions.description: livi Business offers SME Financing solutions designed specifically for small and medium-sized enterprises. This service provides businesses with access to capital needed for growth, operations, or other business purposes. The SME Financing option is part of livi's business banking offerings, reflecting the bank's commitment to supporting Hong Kong's business community. Business customers can apply for and manage their financing through livi's digital platform, with the service incorporating livi's security features to protect business transactions.

promotions.title: BOC Chill Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Special card offering with Bank of China partnership
promotions.description: livi bank offers the BOC Chill Card in partnership with Bank of China. This card provides customers with specific banking features and potential benefits associated with both financial institutions. The BOC Chill Card represents livi's collaborative approach to providing comprehensive banking services. Customers can apply for and manage their BOC Chill Card through the digital platforms provided by livi, with the card incorporating security features to protect transactions.

promotions.title: BOC Mastercard® Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Convenient debit card service with global acceptance
promotions.description: livi bank provides the BOC Mastercard® Debit Card, offering customers a convenient payment method accepted globally. This debit card allows direct access to funds in the customer's livi account for purchases and ATM withdrawals. The card is part of livi's partnership with Bank of China and Mastercard, combining the strengths of these financial institutions. Customers can apply for and manage their debit card through livi's digital platform, with the card incorporating security features to protect against unauthorized use.

promotions.title: livi Business Account
promotions.highlight: 💼 Dedicated business banking solutions
promotions.description: livi Business Account offers specialized banking services tailored for business customers. This account provides the essential banking features needed for business operations and financial management. The account is part of livi's business banking suite, designed to support businesses with their banking needs in a digital environment. Customers can access and manage their business accounts through livi's secure platform, benefiting from the same technological conveniences available in livi's personal banking products.

promotions.title: livi QR Cash Withdrawal
promotions.highlight: 💵 Withdraw cash using QR codes
promotions.description: livi offers a QR Cash withdrawal service allowing customers to withdraw money using QR codes. This service is available to all livi customers with an active account. Users can generate a QR code in the app and use it at compatible ATMs or withdrawal points to access cash without a physical card. The service provides a convenient and secure way to withdraw money.

promotions.description: Open a livi bank account completely online without complicated documents. The process is quick and easy, allowing customers to join anytime, anywhere through the app.

promotions.title: Digital Account Opening in Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ 100% online account opening - quick and easy
promotions.description: Open a livi account completely online without complicated documents. The process is quick and easy, allowing you to start banking from anywhere at any time through the app.

promotions.title: Tax Deduction for Wang Fuk Court Support Fund Donations
promotions.highlight: 💝 Special tax deduction arrangement for Support Fund donations
promotions.description: Donations made to the Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po through bank transfer with an amount of HK$50,000 or below are eligible for tax deductions without requiring official receipts. Donors need to retain relevant donation records for potential review by the Inland Revenue Department.

promotions.title: liviSave No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💸 No fees and no minimum deposit requirements
promotions.description: Open a liviSave account without worrying about fees or minimum balance requirements. This account caters to both paying and saving needs, offering complete flexibility for customers.

promotions.title: Money Safe Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Special rewards for keeping your money safe
promotions.description: livi offers 'Money Safe Rewards' (智安存獎賞) program that provides benefits to customers for maintaining security measures. This program rewards customers for practicing safe banking habits.

promotions.title: No Minimum Deposit Requirement
promotions.highlight: 🆓 No fees and no minimum balance requirements
promotions.description: Open and maintain a liviSave account with no minimum deposit requirement and no maintenance fees. This feature makes the account accessible to everyone regardless of their financial situation.

promotions.title: Instant Loan with Interest Rate as Low as 1.18% and up to HKD10,888 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💸 Get a personal loan with rates as low as 1.18% and cash rewards up to HKD12,888
promotions.description: Get the cash you need with Mox Instant Loan offering personalized quotations to instant disbursement through the Mox app. From now until 31 July 2026, customers who successfully apply for a designated Instant Loan can enjoy up to HKD12,888 in cash rewards. The loan offers attractive interest rates as low as 1.18%. The application process is entirely handled within the app, from personalized quotation to instant disbursement upon approval.

promotions.title: Mox Journey from Scratch Promotion with Rewards up to HKD8,888
promotions.highlight: 🎰 Complete missions to earn scratch cards with prizes up to HKD8,888
promotions.description: Take on any of five simple investment challenges and get a Mox Scratch Card for each completed mission. Scratch and reveal your prize instantly, with more missions completed increasing your chances to win the top prize of HKD8,888 (consisting of HKD8,000 worth of Solana cryptocurrency plus HKD888 cash reward). The promotion runs from 16 March 2026 to 15 June 2026. Note that investment involves risks and quota is limited on a first-come, first-served basis.

promotions.title: Mox x csl Best-in-Town Exclusive Plan with up to HKD1,380 Rebates + Free NowTV Pass
promotions.highlight: 📱 Get up to HKD1,380 rebates on new sign-ups or renewals + free NowTV Pass
promotions.description: Mox Credit Card customers who sign up for a new plan or renew an existing one with csl with Mox Credit Card autopay set up will automatically enjoy an HKD180 monthly fee rebate plus a free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass valued at HKD188. This exclusive offer enhances both connectivity and entertainment in one package. The offer is available to both new sign-ups and existing customers who are renewing their csl mobile plans with a Mox Credit Card for autopay.

promotions.title: Travel Pick & Go Eggstra Care+ Free Add-on Coverage
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Get FREE add-on coverage with Travel Pick & Go insurance
promotions.description: From 4 March to 31 May 2026, customers who apply for the Travel Pick & Go insurance will receive one FREE add-on coverage. This complimentary coverage helps safeguard travelers from financial stress that unexpected events can bring during their trips. The promotion is specifically designed to enhance the travel insurance experience by providing extra protection at no additional cost. Terms and conditions of the Travel Pick & Go Eggstra Care+ promotion apply.
promotions.cost: Travel Pick & Go insurance purchase required

promotions.title: Mox x The Club Samsung S26 Series HKD100 Off Exclusive Offer
promotions.highlight: 🛍️ Enjoy exclusive discounts on curated gifts and tech products
promotions.description: Mox Zone at The Club offers a special selection of New Year spirits, home essentials, and popular tech gear with exclusive discounts for Mox Credit Card users. Featured products include the Hibiki 100th Anniversary Suntory Whisky at HKD5,388 (original price HKD6,888), a wine package of 6 bottles for HKD580, and various tech products at significant discounts. To access these offers, customers need to link their Mox Card to their The Club account. Once linked, customers receive a Privilege Pass activation and can shop at Mox Zone on The Club website or app.
promotions.cost: Purchase with Mox Credit Card required

promotions.title: MOXPAYROLL Invitation Code - Earn up to HKD1,600 for Payroll Customers
promotions.highlight: 💵 Earn up to HKD1,600 in cash rewards by setting up payroll
promotions.description: Open a Mox Account with the invitation code "MOXPAYROLL" by 30 June 2026 and earn HKD400 once your credit card is approved within the following 30 days. You can then earn additional rewards by accumulating eligible payroll transactions in May and June 2026, earning HKD600 each month for a total of up to HKD1,600 in cash rewards. This offer is only applicable to customers who have not held any Mox Account in their name at any time during the 12 months prior to the onboarding date.
promotions.quota: Only for customers who haven't held a Mox Account in the past 12 months

promotions.title: MOXDEPO Invitation Code Time Deposit Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD2,500 cash rewards with a HKD250,000 time deposit
promotions.description: Open a Mox Account using the invitation code "MOXDEPO" by 30 June 2026, complete your account opening within 15 days, place a Time Deposit of at least HKD250,000 within 7 days, and maintain a HKD Time Deposit Account Balance of at least HKD250,000 until the end of the Hold Fund Period to earn HKD2,500 cash rewards. This offer is only applicable to customers who have not held any Mox Account in their name at any time during the 12 months prior to the onboarding date.
promotions.quota: Only for customers who haven't held a Mox Account in the past 12 months

promotions.title: Mox MOXSMART Spend & Save Double Rewards with 20% CashBack
promotions.highlight: 🛒 Get 20% CashBack at selected merchants plus high savings rate
promotions.description: New Mox customers who enter invitation code "MOXSMART" when signing up can enjoy 20% CashBack for a full year when spending on HKTVmall, foodpanda, Uber, Keeta, or Taobao, plus the standard up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on all other spending. Additionally, customers can earn a total welcome savings rate of 12% p.a. from deposits. This double reward promotion provides benefits for both spending and saving activities. Terms and conditions of the MOXSMART Invitation Code Promotion apply.

promotions.title: MOXBILL26 HKT Bills Payment Reward with HKD1,200 Cash
promotions.highlight: 💸 Earn up to HKD1,200 cash rewards paying HKT bills
promotions.description: From now until 30 June 2026, customers who open a Mox Account with the invitation code MOXBILL26, apply for a Mox Credit Card, and pay HKT bills can unlock cash rewards worth up to HKD1,200. This promotion turns the routine expense of bill payment into a rewarding activity. In addition to the special cash rewards, customers will also earn the standard up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on these bill payments. This offer has limited quota on a first-come, first-served basis.

promotions.title: Trip.com Exclusive Discount with Mox Credit Card
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Enjoy up to 8% off + up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on Trip.com
promotions.description: From now until 31 December 2026, Mox customers can use their Mox Card to book hotels or flights on Trip.com and enjoy up to 8% exclusive discounts. When using a Mox Credit Card for these purchases, customers can earn up to an additional 2% Unlimited CashBack on top of the discount. This year-long promotion is designed specifically for Mox customers to maximize savings on travel bookings. The offer applies to both hotel and flight bookings made through the Trip.com platform.

promotions.title: Mission Bonus Rate Savings Program
promotions.highlight: 🚀 Earn up to 3.5% p.a. on deposits by completing missions
promotions.description: Complete four easy missions – route payroll, invest, use FX, or boost daily balance – and earn up to 3.5% p.a. on your HKD or USD Eligible Savings Deposits. Customers can stack any or all of these missions, with the bonus rate kicking in instantly and lasting until the end of the month. The more missions completed, the higher the interest rate earned on deposits. This program rewards customers for engaging with multiple Mox products and services.

promotions.title: CLUBLINK Invitation Code Offer for The Club Membership
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn rewards worth up to HKD1,400 by linking Mox Card to The Club
promotions.description: From now until 30 June 2026, new customers can open a Mox Account with the code "CLUBLINK", link their Mox Card to The Club account, and apply for a Mox Credit Card to earn up to HKD1,400 worth of rewards. This promotion encourages integration between Mox and The Club, HKT's loyalty program, providing additional value for customers who use both services. The rewards are earned by completing specific actions including account opening, card linking, and meeting spending requirements.

promotions.title: New Customer Xiaomi Promotion with XM1500MOX
promotions.highlight: 📱 Up to 7% total cash rewards at Xiaomi + 0% instalments
promotions.description: Shop at mi.com or any Xiaomi Store with your Mox Credit Card and unlock up to 5% extra cash rebate (capped at HKD450) plus up to 12-month 0% interest instalments when you hit the required cumulative spend. Combined with the standard up to 2% Unlimited CashBack, you can earn a total of up to 7% cash rewards. New customers who sign up with invitation code XM1500MOX can earn up to HKD2,150 in additional cash rewards. This offer is specifically for purchases at Xiaomi's official website and physical stores.
promotions.quota: New customers for additional HKD2,150 cash rewards

promotions.title: Mox Invest 0% Fund Subscription Fee (All Fees Waived)
promotions.highlight: 🔥 Enjoy 0% subscription fee on any fund purchase
promotions.description: Mox Invest is offering 0% fund subscription fee on any fund purchase until 30 June 2026. The minimum investment amount is as low as HKD100/USD100, making it easy to start investing. Other fees and charges continue to apply, including annual management fees, custodian fees and/or administration fees with respect to the relevant fund. For details, please refer to the respective fund offering documents. This promotion runs from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026.

promotions.title: Mox 1500MOX Welcome Offer with up to HKD1,500 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD1,500 cash rewards plus 2% Unlimited CashBack with no requirements
promotions.description: New customers who use invitation code "1500MOX" to open a Mox account and apply for a Mox Credit Card can earn up to HKD1,500 in cash rewards by meeting spending requirements at any merchant in Hong Kong. An additional HKD200 cash reward is available when spending on electronics and electronic products. This promotion also unlocks 2% Unlimited CashBack or Unlimited Asia Miles with no balance requirement on all daily spending. Offer is valid until 30 June 2026.

promotions.title: Mox MOXTRIP25 Welcome Offer with up to HKD1,700 Cash Rewards

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Visa Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a truly free banking card option for all users.

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 20% p.a. 7-Day Time Deposit for New Referred Customers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred by existing users can receive two 19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest boost coupons (plus base rate for total 20% p.a.). The first coupon is awarded when depositing ≥ HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening, valid for deposits up to HKD 20,000. A second coupon is granted when maintaining HKD 1,000 balance across deposits, funds and stocks, valid for deposits up to HKD 100,000.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes during the promotion period
promotions.cost: Must deposit ≥ HKD 1,000 for first coupon; must maintain combined balance of HKD 1,000 across deposits, funds and stocks for second coupon

promotions.title: ZA Card StockBack 6th Anniversary 6% Cashback on Coffee
promotions.highlight: ☕ Get 6% stock rebates at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers could earn 6% StockBack rewards when spending at any local coffee merchant using their ZA Card. Qualifying transactions needed to be at least HKD 10 and made directly with the card (not through Alipay or WeChat Pay). The reward cap for special coffee merchant rebates was HKD 50 per user during the promotion period.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; maximum combined special rebates capped at HKD 50 per user
promotions.cost: Minimum spending of HKD 10 per transaction required

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Round-the-clock customer support every day
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24/7 customer service for all users, ensuring assistance is available at any time of day. This always-on support system allows customers to resolve issues, ask questions, and receive guidance regardless of time constraints. The service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to convenient digital banking that overcomes traditional banking limitations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank Refer to Take Out a Loan Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends to ZA Bank loans
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can earn rewards up to HKD 900 by referring friends to apply for loans with ZA Bank. The referral program provides cash incentives when referred friends successfully obtain loan products. Reward amounts vary based on the loan type and amount approved for the referred friend.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free to participate; referred friends must complete loan application and approval process

promotions.title: Wise Express Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Fast international transfers powered by Wise
promotions.description: ZA Bank has partnered with Wise to offer express remittance services for HKD payments, providing faster international transfers than traditional methods. This service enables customers to send money internationally with competitive exchange rates and transparent fee structures. It complements ZA Bank's suite of global transfer options, including SWIFT transfers to over 140 countries.
promotions.cost: Fees vary by destination and amount

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured via smartphone in as little as 3 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a fully digital insurance application process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes via smartphone. Options include life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) with a simplified claims process.

promotions.title: Zero Deposit Requirement for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 💸 Open an account with zero deposit requirement
promotions.description: ZA Bank allows both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong to open a bank account online with no minimum deposit requirement. This zero-barrier entry makes banking accessible to everyone regardless of their initial deposit amount.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong

promotions.title: 24x7 Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: ⏰ Exchange currencies anytime with 24/7 availability
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can exchange between 11 currencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week at their preferred rates. This allows users to seize market opportunities at any time and grow their wealth through flexible currency exchange.

promotions.title: Currency Exchange Discount Voucher HKD 126
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get HKD 126 discount on currency exchange
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher as part of the new customer reward package. The voucher is valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used for eligible currency exchange transactions.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: HKD 100 Overseas Remittance Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Receive HKD 100 rebate on overseas remittance
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 100 overseas remittance cash rebate voucher as part of the welcome package. The voucher can be applied to eligible overseas remittance transactions within 30 days of receipt.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Metal Card Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💳 Win an exclusive metal card worth HKD 1,000
promotions.description: Top 60 users with the highest StockBack points in each of three phases during the 6th anniversary promotion will receive a premium StockBack x ZA Card metal card valued at HKD 1,000.
promotions.quota: Top 60 users per phase; Maximum one card per user during promotion
promotions.cost: Free, but requires active participation in StockBack activities

promotions.title: ZA Card with No Annual or Hidden Fees
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient mobile payments.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary Coffee Merchant Promotion
promotions.highlight: ☕ 6% stock rewards at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: Customers can earn 6% stock rewards on eligible transactions at all local coffee merchants when spending with their ZA Card during the promotion period. Maximum reward is capped at HKD 50 per customer combining both 6% and 12% offers.
promotions.quota: Maximum HKD 50 combined reward per customer

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at Visa ATMs in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 💵 Free cash withdrawals at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong
promotions.description: ZA Card holders can withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs throughout Hong Kong. This permanent feature allows customers to access their money without incurring withdrawal fees at supported ATMs.

promotions.title: Open an Account in as Fast as 2 Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Quick and easy account opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as fast as 2 minutes when no extra information is required. This service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong.

promotions.title: ZA Credit Loan Referral Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Invite friends to apply for loans at ZA Bank and receive cash rewards up to HKD 900 when they successfully take out a loan. The more friends you refer, the more rewards you can earn.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance in 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via smartphone
promotions.description: Complete the insurance application process in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone. Choose from various insurance products including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) options.
promotions.cost: Insurance premiums vary by product and coverage

promotions.title: ZA Bank Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees
promotions.description: Trade stocks with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees. Platform fees as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction. Trade directly with your HKD or USD deposits in your ZA Bank account.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank investment account holders
promotions.cost: Platform fee starting from USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: 0 Brokerage and 0 Custody Fee Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 🏦 0 commission and 0 custody fees on all HK stock trades
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18 per transaction. This permanent feature allows unlimited trading without paying traditional brokerage commissions, significantly reducing trading costs.
promotions.quota: All users with active stock trading accounts
promotions.cost: Platform fee from HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Platform Fee for New Crypto Customers
promotions.highlight: 🪙 $0 platform fee for crypto trading for first 90 days
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy $0 platform fee for cryptocurrency trading for the first 90 days after account opening. Trade 24/7 directly with HKD or USD deposits.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Hong Kong Stocks Trading Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Up to HKD 1,500 cash rewards for new stock trading customers
promotions.description: New customers who activate Hong Kong stocks trading can receive up to HKD 500 cash rewards through ZA Quest, plus up to HKD 1,000 cash rebate when buying stocks. Enjoy 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.

promotions.title: Hong Kong's No.1 Digital Bank
promotions.highlight: 🏆 First digital bank in Hong Kong with highest user base and deposits
promotions.description: As the first digital bank to launch in Hong Kong, ZA Bank had the highest number of users and customer deposits among the city's eight digital banks as of 30 June 2024. ZA Bank offers 24x7 banking services with convenient digital features.

promotions.title: Refer a Friend for Loan Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Earn up to HKD 900 by referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Existing customers can earn up to HKD 900 in rewards for successfully referring friends who take out loans with ZA Bank. This incentive program rewards customers for bringing in new loan customers.
promotions.quota: All existing ZA Bank account holders

promotions.title: HKD 1,000 Monthly Fee Savings on Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 💰 Save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading fees compared to traditional brokers
promotions.description: ZA Bank's stock trading service can save customers up to HKD 1,000 in monthly fees compared to traditional brokers. This calculation is based on making one trade per trading day (approximately 20 trades per month) with zero commission, zero custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.
promotions.cost: Platform fees apply (from HKD 18 per transaction)

promotions.title: 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🧑‍💼 Round-the-clock customer support
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 24x7 customer service support to all users. Banking services are always available regardless of time of day, with full customer service access.

promotions.title: Customer Referral Program - Referrer Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🤝 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: ZA Bank's customer referral program rewards users for referring friends to open accounts. Referrers can earn various rewards based on the number of successful referrals, with top referrers eligible for up to HKD 10,000 per phase across 9 phases of the campaign.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Brokerage & 0% Custody Fees for Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 📈 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees for Hong Kong stocks
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with zero commission and zero custody fees. Platform fee is as low as HKD 18 per transaction, allowing users to save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading costs compared to traditional brokers.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank users with activated stock trading services
promotions.cost: Platform fee as low as HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: New User HKD 500 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💵 Get up to HKD 500 cash reward when opening a new account
promotions.description: Selected customers can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards when opening a new ZA Bank account. Customers can complete specific tasks in ZA Quest after successful account opening to receive the reward.
promotions.quota: Selected new customers only; not applicable to customers who opened accounts through referral programs or have received other new customer gifts

promotions.title: New Account HKD 2,026 Welcome Reward
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Get rewards worth HKD 2,026 plus 2.5% stock rebate
promotions.description: New users who open an account using a referral code can receive rewards worth HKD 2,026 including fund position rebate vouchers and stock cash rebate vouchers. Additionally, they can enjoy 2.5% stock rebate on eligible purchases.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Account Opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an account in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that allows customers to open an account in as little as 2 minutes. The service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong with zero deposit requirements.

promotions.title: Fund Redemption Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Redemption fee waivers for all funds
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers who have activated fund trading services can enjoy redemption fee waivers for all funds until July 31, 2026. This allows investors to redeem their fund investments without paying any redemption fees.
promotions.quota: All retail banking users who have activated fund trading services
